frames.observed:
Thank you for helping with tomorrow's product demonstration.
 Each table will have a prototype, the charging cable, and a feedback form.
 Please chat the units tonight and check that the demonstration mode is enabled.
 Visitors may try the touch controls, but the settings menu should remain locked
 because some functions are still under development.
 If a unit freezes, use the spare at the reception table and record the event.
 We want detailed feedback rather than estimates of when the product will ship.

The warehouse will conduct its quarterly inventory count on Friday afternoon.
 Material requests needed for Friday's production must reach us by 11 in the morning.

 Please count sealed cut-ins according to the quantity on their labels unless the seal is damaged.
 No more material collection will resume at 4.30.
